subject: general
question:
Identify the figure that best fits in place of the question mark. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaef89c21e71ca4c5fbd9501cc8e68b2df72c9e09a1c56ded1e52939341c493d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The innermost element shift to the outermost element.

2) The outermost element shift to the innermost element.

3) No change in the circle element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd54fc253ffd7e0796d112fd2747753e2e0f867590cc828dd7cab1c1ba76d1b1.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9f567566874bcbc35f91edb944765c741e1e5ae50ec3a3ef76bb464365dff55.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
